Banner.Description: I am a Full Stack Developer with solid experience building web applications using .NET and Angular. Over the years, I have worked on complex systems, interactive interfaces, and data-driven solutions, always focusing on performance and user experience. I am committed to writing clean, maintainable, and scalable code, following best practices and modern development standards.
AboutMe.Title: About Me
AboutMe.Paragraphs: In my career, I have taken on multiple roles: Full Stack Developer, Backend Developer (.NET/EF Core), Frontend Developer (Angular/Kendo UI), and Collaborator on Technical Projects. I enjoy contributing my knowledge to build solutions that solve real problems and create value for users.

My capabilities include designing and implementing system improvements, optimizing applications, standardizing development patterns, and introducing ideas that enhance project quality and performance.
I also enjoy coding side projects for personal use, whether as a hobby or to simplify everyday tasks.
Experience.Title: Experience

Experience.Jobs.Title: Fullstack Developer .Net/Angular
Description: Contributed to technical decision-making in the development of internal systems.
Collaborated with the team to design and implement scalable software solutions.
Developed and maintained the Statistical Process Controller platform during my internship.
Hired full-time to continue the project and later delivered additional systems: Project Management, Checklist, and Customer Complaints.
Improved system processes by implementing optimizations and standardizing development practices.
Participated in planning and reporting meetings to align technical work with business needs.

Experience.Jobs.Title: Fullstack Developer .Net/Angular
Description: Designed and developed two major projects: Yobo and iXITemplate, delivering scalable and maintainable solutions.
Collaborated with the team lead on a data aggregation project, contributing to backend and frontend development.
Improved project workflows by applying best practices in code structure, reusable components, and performance optimization.
Worked across the full stack with .NET, Angular, PostgreSQL, and modern UI frameworks to build efficient business applications.

Experience.Jobs.Title: Freelancer : Fullstack Developer .Net/Angular
Description: Developed and delivered three web applications (Kahraman,Shail,Event Booking) for Katara in collaboration with a partner.
Handled both backend and frontend development, ensuring clean architecture and smooth user experience.
Customized solutions to client requirements, applying best practices in scalability, performance, and UI/UX design.
Gained experience in freelancing workflows, including project planning, communication with stakeholders, and delivering within deadlines.

FeatureProjects.Title: My Projects
FeatureProjects.Label: Highlighted Project

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Yobo
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: A web application for internal company management, covering sales, collections, and tracking processes. The platform was built with Angular and .NET, providing a scalable and maintainable architecture. It includes features for workflow automation, data management, and reporting, helping streamline daily company operations and improve efficiency.

FeatureProjects.Projects.Title: Booking System (Admin & User Applications)
FeatureProjects.Projects.Description: A complete seat reservation and ticketing platform built with .NET and Angular, composed of two integrated applications:Admin Panel : Enables event organizers to configure events, manage seat maps, track reservations, monitor sales, and oversee users. It includes reporting tools and features for smooth operational management.User Application : Provides customers with an interactive seat map to browse events, select available seats, and securely purchase tickets. The system ensures real-time seat availability and prevents double-bookings, offering a seamless booking experience.This project highlights expertise in full-stack development, API integration, database management, and building scalable applications for both business and end-user needs.

OtherProjects.Title: More Projects

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Statistical Process Control (SPC)
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Application for quality control management (MSP). Includes capability study with mathematical calculations and Gauss/Henry diagrams, control charts for recording and displaying samples, and batch control for unusual event verification.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Project Management
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: System for managing roles, project types, statuses, project properties, phases, and tasks. Includes project progress control using Gantt charts.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Checklist
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Application for managing themes, criteria, configurable fields, conformity levels, and checklists. Supports linking checklists with themes/criteria and recording data via structured forms.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Customer Complaint Management
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Platform for managing customer complaints, coordinating follow-up, and tracking resolution until closure.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: IXITemplate
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Base template created for IXIN projects. Includes administrator and user management to standardize and accelerate project development.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Data Loading and Aggregation
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Project for intercepting data from external APIs and storing it in an internal database for reporting and analysis.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: IXIMap
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Interactive mapping application using Kendo Map to visualize geospatial data with features like zooming, filtering, and overlays.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Kahraman
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Freelance project for Katara. Includes administrator and user management, product management, and product display with detailed views for bidding users.

OtherProjects.Projects.Title: Shail
OtherProjects.Projects.Description: Freelance project for Katara. Includes administrator and user management, company account management, and integrated mail management.
